LanguageData.SaveYourStorage_SettingsCategory: Save Your Storage and Tick Every Minute
LanguageData.SaveYourStorage_ListerIndex: Use a membership index for global Thing listers
LanguageData.SaveYourStorage_ListerIndexTip: Makes ListerThings.Contains use an incrementally maintained set. Falls back to the original list scan if the index cannot prove that it is exact.
LanguageData.SaveYourStorage_DenseCellLayoutCache: Cache scans and item positions in high-density cells
LanguageData.SaveYourStorage_DenseCellLayoutCacheTip: Caches item counts and calculates visual positions together in dense cells, avoiding repeated full-cell scans. Real Thing positions and identities are unchanged.
LanguageData.SaveYourStorage_SinglePassStorageCheck: Use a single-pass dense-cell storage check
LanguageData.SaveYourStorage_SinglePassStorageCheckTi: Counts items while checking blockers instead of scanning a dense cell a second time. Storage acceptance and stacking rules remain unchanged.
LanguageData.SaveYourStorage_MergeCandidateBuckets: Index merge-job candidates by stack type
LanguageData.SaveYourStorage_MergeCandidateBucketsTip: Builds one short-lived candidate index per vanilla storage group, then performs the original live validation. Custom CanStackWith and custom slot-group implementations use the original enumeration.
LanguageData.SaveYourStorage_DenseCellMinimumItems: High-density optimization threshold: {0} Thing groups per cell
LanguageData.SaveYourStorage_OuterrealmThrottleTip: Coalesces lease-expiry returns and spreads them across ticks. Other Outerrealm Tech storage operations are not intercepted.
LanguageData.SaveYourStorage_OuterrealmTimeBudget: Identity-anchor time budget per tick: {0} ms
